Foyer 2.0.0 can now update itself to Lounge: press **Update now**.

- This release also carries Foyer-named copies of each download, so Foyer 2.0.0's built-in updater finds it and upgrades in place (installer, zip or full screen experience package). Your library, progress, stats and settings carry over.
- Lounge's own updater prefers the Lounge files.

Everything new since Foyer 2.0.0 is in the [2.1.0 release notes](https://github.com/thomasxd24/vlc-fse/releases/tag/v2.1.0): the rename to Lounge, the Apps tab, Tailscale controls, Legion Go controller battery and attach state with a controller tester, quiet Steam launches, playtime stats, audio and subtitle languages, and SFTP/FTP transfers.
